mapper.select: SELECT DATE(create_time) AS studyDate, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(is_correct) AS correctCount, SUM(score_got) AS totalScore FROM user_question_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY studyDate

SELECT r.id AS recordId, r.user_answer AS userAnswer, r.create_time AS answerTime, q.id AS questionId, q.title, q.type, q.difficulty, q.answer AS correctAnswer, q.analysis, kp.name AS knowledgeName FROM user_question_record r JOIN question q ON r.question_id = q.id LEFT JOIN knowledge_point kp ON q.knowledge_id = kp.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_correct = 0 ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_question_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_correct = 0
